info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Order Update API
info.description: The Order Update API allows for the modification of existing orders within the operational services framework. By employing this API, businesses can efficiently adjust order details such as quantities, delivery information, or status updates in a seamless manner. Typical consumers include order management systems and e-commerce platforms looking to enhance order handling capabilities. This API plays a crucial role in maintaining order accuracy and improving customer satisfaction through timely updates.

patch.description: This endpoint allows users to update the details of a specific processing order identified by RES-100045. All relevant fields can be modified as necessary to reflect the current state of the order.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update an existing processing order with identification RES-100045. It should contain the necessary fields to reflect the updated state of the order.

200.description: The request was successful and the resource has been updated.
